# Browser libraries

These pinned browser libraries are served locally so charts and PNG export do not depend on a CDN at runtime. Keep each upstream `LICENSE` file beside its corresponding JavaScript file.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` records the downloaded JavaScript file hashes for integrity checks.

| Library | Version | Upstream file | License |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Chart.js | 4.4.1 | [chart.js](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js) | `chartjs/LICENSE` |
| chartjs-adapter-date-fns | 3.0.0 | [adapter](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chartjs-adapter-date-fns@3.0.0/dist/chartjs-adapter-date-fns.bundle.min.js) | `chartjs-adapter-date-fns/LICENSE` |
| chartjs-plugin-annotation | 3.0.1 | [annotation](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chartjs-plugin-annotation@3.0.1/dist/chartjs-plugin-annotation.min.js) | `chartjs-plugin-annotation/LICENSE` |
| chartjs-plugin-zoom | 2.0.1 | [zoom](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chartjs-plugin-zoom@2.0.1/dist/chartjs-plugin-zoom.min.js) | `chartjs-plugin-zoom/LICENSE` |
| html2canvas | 1.4.1 | [html2canvas](https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js) | `html2canvas/LICENSE` |
